framework.method: RAKL v3 Verified Discovery / proposal-shadow experience substrate

initial_ci.failure_signature: The framework PR153 compatibility test discovers top-level episode_id in research JSON as canonical episode-inventory candidates. Two non-episode diagnostic containers and one proposal/shadow TaskEpisode were therefore outside the frozen/validated inventory set.

correction.task_episode: preserved the unchanged strict-hash proposal/shadow TaskEpisode payload as NS-B1a3b_C001_V3_TASK_EPISODE_20260811.json.shadow, keeping it outside canonical episode-inventory discovery until a protected registration gate explicitly admits it

post_ci_method_case_study.what_failed: application inventory representation/tooling, not mathematics, retrieval, decomposition, or source verification
post_ci_method_case_study.what_worked: CI falsified an invalid representation choice before merge; retaining proposal/shadow episode evidence outside canonical inventory restored the exact pinned suite without changing the mathematical result or the TaskEpisode content hash
post_ci_method_case_study.v3_feature_helped: the authority boundary made it correct to keep the episode proposal/shadow rather than forcing canonical inventory admission
post_ci_method_case_study.v3_or_application_feature_missing: no first-class prospective sidecar/registration convention distinguishes new proposal TaskEpisode evidence from the frozen canonical episode inventory scanner
post_ci_method_case_study.framework_improvement_hypothesis: Define an explicit proposal/shadow TaskEpisode sidecar convention or registration gate so application CI does not infer canonical inventory intent merely from a top-level episode_id. Treat this as a hypothesis from one observed integration failure, not a framework defect claim.

learning_policy: The CI correction is assurance/tooling state only. File, commit, PR, and prose growth are not counted as learning, and all seven semantic novelty deltas for this correction are explicit zeroes.
